hypotheses.R0_program_is_state_dominant: The frozen program has at least 0.80 Euclidean state-energy fidelity to the complete attention-write change at all four sites.
hypotheses.R1_semantic_contrast_is_exceptional: At least two sites exceed the 95th percentile matched-random-contrast fidelity by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.R2_discovery_head_remains_best_heldout: The discovery top head has the best mean held-out singleton fidelity at every site.
hypotheses.R3_layer9_heads_are_family_specific: At Layer 9, H8 beats H7 on spelling and H7 beats H8 on sentiment by at least 0.10 energy fidelity.
